name: every-path-into-the-repairer-refuses-a-collision
find:
refuse_colliding_filenames([Path(p).name for p in photo_paths],
                               [str(p) for p in photo_paths])
breaks: a path into the alt text repairer stops refusing two photographs that share a basename, so the filename to path mapping folds them into one key: one photograph is silently missing and a marker naming it attaches the other, which reads as correct and is not (#1364, #1130)
